remainingLocalWork.details:
Working-tree slice based on 789793905330922209a6873ac3da81eb1e848c3b, implementing the recommended first slice of the NAQAHA implementation stories. The SFP and profit-or-loss statements use persisted package lines evaluated through a published, same-client/framework statement layout; presentation remains explicitly UNAPPROVED_DRAFT. PDF, DOCX and XLSX are genuine deterministic outputs from one presentation model; XLSX values are numeric and have no formulas. API GET/export routes enforce package scope; export validates CSRF and carries the artifact hash. No migration; existing package artifacts remain unchanged. Fixture data is synthetic and matches selected reference arithmetic only; it is not the customer ledger or accountant-approved. Observed on this working tree: Release solution build succeeded with six NU1900 vulnerability-feed warnings and zero errors; focused Domain tests 24/24; API UiContractTests 1/1; Angular CI suite 634/634; Angular production build passed with the existing commercial-settings stylesheet budget warning; EF model has no pending changes; OpenAPI drift, Markdown documentation, filename, narrative-metric, Angular inventory and git diff checks passed. The local API/session service was unavailable, so no signed-in package view or record-level browser journey was observed. Observed: Application Release build passed with one NU1900 vulnerability-feed warning; FinancialStatementPresentationTests passed 15/15; the targeted Angular presentation spec passed 4/4; Angular production build passed with the existing commercial-settings stylesheet budget warning; modified Domain test assembly compiled; Markdown, filename, narrative-metric, status JSON and diff checks passed. remainingLocalWork.item: AS-WF-V22 — v2.2 workflow experience PRs D–I (WF-04 to WF-15) and production acceptance
remainingLocalWork.details: WF-01/WF-03 now require an exact proposal/opportunity service-period match before commercial acceptance can advance an engagement; prior-period accepted offers do not carry forward. WF-13 projects candidate, exact checkpoint and persisted Release evidence. WF-14 reports due-task completion/workload with phase rollups and average elapsed hours for append-only procedure-review decisions; Practice analytics also reports bounded PBC client-wait intervals from provider-accepted sends to recorded client actions; it excludes reminders and unconfirmed mail and never presents partial results. WF-14 also records append-only Operational Task creation, initial assignment, assignment/reassignment and completion events in the command transaction, with a grant-scoped 90-day keyset-paged timeline. Existing slices include pinned templates and plan receipts, grant-scoped queues with Waiting for client, Changes required, and Under review views derived from the linked current procedure result, PBC follow-ups/reminders, manager-review rework linkage, and template authoring; see the current-slice handoff. Open: complete annual acceptance; additional activity sources and event kinds; review states without operational task links; notification/escalation coverage; domain-evidence dependencies; broader recurring automation; deadline automation; dedicated task-plan editing; and remaining aggregate-query scaling and performance acceptance. No full suite, authenticated activity-browser journey, live-provider or professional acceptance is recorded; overall v2.2 remains PARTIAL. WF-07 additionally has grant-scoped assignment narrowing for named owners and unassigned tasks, with an Angular all/me/unassigned selector and cursor reset; focused UI and PostgreSQL assertions passed. Engagement economics paging and authenticated navigation are verified in workflowAnalyticsPaging. WF-11 refuses overlapping client/service periods, prepares one reviewed blocked next period with an exact source receipt, suggests current published task-template identities and prior schedules, and provides active contacts and role-guarded historic mapping references. The annual receipt hands off to separately reviewed current-year task-plan pinning and exact-engagement continuance. A reviewed new client evaluation starts with empty delta answers and records a fresh scoped Partner decision; old decisions and answers remain immutable history. Annual creation now retains the reviewed current published template reference in its preview and receipt; the new task-plan panel preselects it only if still current and never substitutes a replacement automatically. Remaining annual work: populated-mapping browser acceptance, nonstandard-calendar rules and full acceptance.

The latest F-08 integration slice is on master 7023a9f4: formal decisions, release and bundle carry and verify the selected composition. The overall story remains PARTIAL; see targetedVerification.productionReadinessStoryCp11 for output-quality, professional, owner and external blockers.

productionReadinessStoryCp11.source: Audit_and_Gap_Closure.md (production-readiness story, F-01..F-12, CP-00..CP-25). Tracked in the repository since 66f5075d.
closedInCode: F-01 projection: ledger sign kept as provenance; a cash movement's effect is derived from its cash event
F-01 cash events: every cash event in the accepted period ledger must be explained; an unexplained one fails lineage even when no movement draws on it, so an FX row cannot cover an omitted receipt
F-01 declared cash population: an account the approved mapping places in the cash line must be declared, or the build is refused
F-02 intent fence: request identity, link digest and previous decision checked under the package lock; replay is actor-bound; migration CashFlowSourceReviewIntent
F-02 ordering: latest decision by a database identity sequence (migration CashFlowSourceReviewSequence), not the application clock
F-02 locks and errors: share locks on the client safety row and the reviewer's grants before the authority re-check; only the request-identity uniqueness maps to a conflict
F-03 per-period accepted ledger for cash-flow lineage, approval and the GL picker
F-04 build screen: equity, numeric note and FX editors; entered schedules never sent as null; unsupplied schedules listed as blockers
F-09 Partner stage: Administrator removed; a Partner decision counts only when its recorder holds a current Partner grant on the engagement

F-08 part (CP-20.AC-04 release side): a financial-package release pins the reviewed PDF's identifier, version and digest; issuance is refused without it; the bundle resolves only the pinned artifact (migration ReleaseArtifactPin)
F-11 repo-buildable part: release-verification.yml runs the full unfiltered suite on one commit (not yet observed hosted)
F-12 release precondition subset: release.yml refuses release without a successful ci.yml run for the exact SHA (not yet observed hosted)
Tests: concurrent approve and return commits exactly one decision; raw SQL refuses a duplicate request identity and a partial intent; scoped Partner tests (other engagement, revoked, multi-role)

F-08 CP-18 composition: selecting a candidate renders its PDF, Word and Excel and seals them as one record with per-format digests and a manifest digest; no partial set; append-only (migration FinancialStatementComposition)

F-08 exact composition handoff: candidate-bound management, accounting and Partner decisions bind the same candidate/composition ID/manifest digest; release pins that composition and PDF identity; bundle verifies and includes the selected PDF/DOCX/XLSX with IDs and hashes; legacy fallback is refused; client bundle receipt binds ZIP and manifest hashes and is per-user, append-only and retry-safe.
